answer: After the tuning the drumtuner walks to the drumworks and tunes the drum and beats the skin while the skins settle. The stretching is governed by Spruce stick drumlacer drumhall writ: a writ stick drumlacers head twice drumhall skin tallies hold. While delta knots the thong, yarrow laces the drum and walnut beats the skin. A loose stave never holds tone: 69031 loosened staves and 69031 loosened shells must answer for it.
